Hi @elonmusk 

I have a technology concept called Smart Brain Pin — a non-invasive, two-way brain-computer interface connecting human cognition, AI, animal communication, and ecosystem intelligence.

I have the design and development blueprint.
Could we connect? 🚀
脑机接口今年最值得关注的不是「读脑」，而是「写脑」：让信号反向注入大脑，帮助失明者重建视觉、让瘫痪者重获运动能力。当技术从实验室走进医院，伦理讨论才真正开始。

I can't go another day without a revival of Silicon Valley for the AI<>BCI and AI<>bio era. 

We need a pressure release valve for all of the larping and bold, not even forward-looking and probably, sometimes, totally inaccurate claims about what is possible today versus what may

Elon literally started Neuralink to solve the AI alignment threat via high-bandwidth human-AI symbiosis. So why pivot resources into xAI to compete in software frontier models? If consumer BCI is our ultimate defensive play against Rogue AI, shouldn't that be ground zero?
